T: Pancakes the size of a hubcap.
D: A lovable slob uncle looks after his brother's three kids for the week.
P: Serve the sweets when Buck flips the giant pancake.
S: Buttery popcorn for the birthday party. Pop 120g popcorn kernels and toss with 50g butter and salt.
Crisp fries with gravy. Bake 1kg frozen chips and serve with 300ml gravy made from powder.
M: Bacon, eggs and sausages on toast, Buck's kind of cooking. Fry 8 rashers bacon and 8 sausages, then 4 eggs.
W: One enormous pancake cooked in the biggest pan you own, with butter and syrup. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 400ml milk.
K: Cold milk to wash down the pancake. Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 glasses.

s.how: Pop 120g popcorn kernels and toss with 50g butter and salt. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table. Put it out before the opening credits so everyone can graze.
Bake 1kg frozen chips and serve with 300ml gravy made from powder. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Fry 8 rashers bacon and 8 sausages, then 4 eggs. Serve on buttered toast. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 400ml milk. Pour half into a large buttered frying pan, cook until bubbles appear, flip with a plate and cook through. Repeat. Serve with butter and 200ml maple syrup.

d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
